title: VUA recipe-export command v0.1
description: The recipe-export word-row command face (proposal 029 B-face freeze loop 1, core batch 2026-09-22). v0.1 carries exactly one method, recipe.exportProjectDraft: derive a RECIPE DRAFT (not a Recipe) from one registered Unity project by reading it through the standing proposal-013 inspection aggregate (VPM manifest declared dependencies and locked pins, the observed editor version, the VUA-native identity tri-state) — a synchronous read-only query with NO tasked command face: the scan touches local project files only (no Bridge, no network), so there is nothing to cancel and nothing to recover; the packages-ops preview/query precedent applies. projectPath is the same registered-path identity the proposal-013 read face uses; an unregistered path answers the REUSED typed not-found vua.project.project_not_found (same fact, same code — packages-query v0.1 precedent), and the validation face is the 013 inspection aggregate exactly as for project.inspectProject. A failed on-disk observation is NOT an error of this face: an absent manifest yields an honest empty dependencies array and an unreadable ProjectVersion.txt yields unityVersionConstraint null plus the environmentUnityVersion entry in the draft's missing list — honesty rules 1/2, never padded, never guessed. The draft this method returns is the zero-bridge skeleton (ruling: proposal 029 open item 4 resolved for option B — the relation face is never scanned in v0.1); the new read-only Bridge scan (option A) is registered as a candidate protocol-bump decision and deliberately NOT implemented or scheduled.

projectPath.description: The registered project path (proposal-013 identity). Exactly one key is accepted; any extra key is a vua.recipe_export.invalid_params shape violation, never a default.
